name: clustering_coefficient
author: 7b0e9b7e
description: Measures how tightly knit a node's neighbourhood is: the local clustering coefficient is the fraction of pairs of a node's neighbours that are themselves linked (1 = all neighbours know each other, 0 = none do). Use for questions like 'how tightly knit is Alice's circle?' or 'how clustered is this network overall?'. Works on undirected and directed graphs (directed graphs use the directed-triangle definition); edge weights are ignored. With a node, returns that node's clustering and degree plus the graph average; without a node, returns the graph's average clustering and the top_k most clustered nodes.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to analyse.

node.description: Optional id of one node whose clustering coefficient is wanted, e.g. 'm1' in karate. Use lookup_node to find the id from a name. Leave out to rank all nodes.

top_k.description: How many of the most clustered nodes to return when no node is given.
